differences_from_chimera: steps run one at a time (onePass with parallelism 1)
no library references or library reuse
every step on the one worker model, the combine on a fixed model

a worker step's reply content is cut after 6144 tokens and scored as a runaway in content (the reply cap: Hydra Worker's num_predict, the cap Chimera should hold every step's content to); thinking doesn't count toward it. Chimera 0.7.0 sends no num_predict and no think field and has no cap
every reply, thinking included, is cut after 16384 tokens (the runaway guard; a worker reply cut there while still thinking is scored as a runaway in thinking; Chimera has no guard)
eval_only: EVAL ONLY: model output for eval plans, never training data
